title: Zindaan Ch Musa Kazim Di Raat Akhri Hai
body:
Bay Jurm Chodah Saal Di (x2) Aj Qaid Muk Gayee Ay
<<DIVIDER>>
Aida Howay Koi Waris
Jera Aa Janaza Chaway (x2)
Be Varisanday Wangun (x2)
Aidi Laash Pull Tey Pai Ay
<<DIVIDER>>
Mango Duwain Jag Tey
Enjh Da Na Qaidi Howay (x2)
Jeidi Peerh Tey Jawani (x2)
Qaidan Chay Rul Gai Ay
<<DIVIDER>>
Vasday Shaihir Janaza
Mazdooran Nay Hai Chaya (x2)
Gurbat Di Aaj Ay Maula (x2)

<<DIVIDER>>
Maiyat Nu Chad Kay Tur Gay
Na Bayriyan Lahaiyan (x2)

<<DIVIDER>>
Mumtaz Likh Kay Nauha
Maula E Moosa Kazim (x2)
Ronda Kalam Ay Mera (x2)
Tehreer Rondi Paiye
